Daily.title: Daily tracking
Daily.subtitle: Day-by-day operational detail for a single facility: what happened, how it compares to similar previous days, and which time slots are worth scheduling no matter what.
Daily.selectPromptTitle: Search for the facility you want to see
Daily.selectPromptSubtitle: This view is per facility — it has no aggregated network or market overview.
Daily.noGamesToday: No games recorded this day at {facility}. Pick another day from the strip above.

evolution.title: Confirmation trend — last {n} {weekday}
evolution.subtitle: Same facility, same day of week
evolution.empty: Not enough {weekday} history yet to chart a trend.

game.missing: {n, plural, one{Short # player for the minimum} other{Short # players for the minimum}}

mustSchedule.section: Slots worth scheduling no matter what
mustSchedule.description: Rolling 3-month window (from the day chosen above) · above 55% confirmation (or cancellation, depending on the view) · cancellations for facility unavailability are fully excluded. Methodology specific to this page — different from the historical consistency used by Trends.
mustSchedule.dayOfWeekIntro: This facility's full history, every time slot — the standout from each day.
mustSchedule.topSlotsIntro: ≥90% over the last 3 months · average of its confirmed games.
mustSchedule.topSlotsEmpty: No slots with 90%+ confirmation at this facility yet.
mustSchedule.strugglingIntro: Declining or stuck below the threshold.
mustSchedule.strugglingEmpty: No declining or stuck slots to report.
mustSchedule.topCancelIntro: ≥90% cancellation over the last 3 months · average of its cancelled games.
mustSchedule.topCancelEmpty: No slots with 90%+ cancellation at this facility yet.
mustSchedule.deficitSuffix: {n, plural, one{ · short # player on average} other{ · short # players on average}}
mustSchedule.strugglingCancelEmpty: No worsening or stuck cancellation slots to report.

glossary.confirmationRateDef: confirmed / (confirmed + cancelled), excluding cancellations for facility unavailability from the calculation.
glossary.cancellationRateDef: the exact complement: cancelled / (confirmed + cancelled), with the same exclusion. It's the same data window seen the other way around, not a new metric.

insights.noGames: No games recorded this {weekday} at this facility.
insights.confirmationInLine: Today's confirmation ({rate}) is in line with the average of the last {n} {weekday} ({avg}).
insights.confirmationAbove: Today's confirmation ({rate}) is {pts} pts above the average of the last {n} {weekday} ({avg}) — good sign.
insights.confirmationBelow: Today's confirmation ({rate}) is {pts} pts below the average of the last {n} {weekday} ({avg}) — worth checking what changed.
insights.gamesMore: {n, plural, one{There was # more game} other{There were # more games}} than the usual average for this day ({avg} games).
insights.gamesLess: {n, plural, one{There was # fewer game} other{There were # fewer games}} than the usual average for this day ({avg} games).
insights.noBaseline: Not enough history of previous {weekday} at this facility yet to compare against a reliable baseline.
insights.topCancelReason: The most frequent cancellation reason today was "{reason}" ({count} of {total} cancelled).
insights.trendSummary: Over the last {n} weeks, {weekday} confirmation shows {trend}: it went from {first} to {last} (min {min}, max {max}).
insights.noWeeklyHistory: Not enough history of 6 {weekday} yet to analyze the multi-week trend.
insights.todayInLine: Today's behavior is in line with the recent trend of the last {n} {weekday} (~{avg}).
insights.todayAbove: Today was {pts} pts above the recent trend (~{avg} over the last {n} {weekday}) — could be a one-off improvement or the start of a trend change, worth confirming next week.
insights.todayBelow: Today was {pts} pts below the recent trend (~{avg} over the last {n} {weekday}) — worth checking whether it's a one-off or the start of a sustained decline.

dayOfWeekSummary.noVariation: {pct} confirmation · {n} games — no meaningful variation between days.
dayOfWeekSummary.strongest: {pct} confirmation · {n} games — the strongest day of the week at this facility.
dayOfWeekSummary.weakest: {pct} confirmation · {n} games — the weakest day of the week, worth checking what explains it.
dayOfWeekSummary.relativeAbove: {pct} confirmation · {n} games — above the weekly average ({avg}).
dayOfWeekSummary.relativeBelow: {pct} confirmation · {n} games — below the weekly average ({avg}).
dayOfWeekSummary.lowOccupancy: Low occupancy in confirmed games ({pct}) — room to fill them more.
dayOfWeekSummary.topSlots: {n, plural, one{# time slot} other{# time slots}} with very high confirmation, the best at {hour} ({pct}).
dayOfWeekSummary.watchSlots: {n, plural, one{# time slot} other{# time slots}} to watch{decliningSuffix}.

dayOfWeekCancelSummary.noVariation: {pct} cancellation · {n} games — no meaningful variation between days.
dayOfWeekCancelSummary.best: {pct} cancellation · {n} games — the day with the fewest cancellations of the week at this facility.
dayOfWeekCancelSummary.worst: {pct} cancellation · {n} games — the day with the most cancellations of the week, worth checking what explains it.
dayOfWeekCancelSummary.relativeAbove: {pct} cancellation · {n} games — above the weekly average ({avg}).
dayOfWeekCancelSummary.relativeBelow: {pct} cancellation · {n} games — below the weekly average ({avg}).
dayOfWeekCancelSummary.lowConversion: Low conversion ({pct}) — a good share of those who sign up never make it to the game (drop-outs or waitlist that never got in).
dayOfWeekCancelSummary.topSlots: {n, plural, one{# time slot} other{# time slots}} with very high cancellation, the most critical at {hour} ({pct}).
dayOfWeekCancelSummary.watchSlots: {n, plural, one{# time slot} other{# time slots}} to watch{worseningSuffix}.

mustScheduleInsight.base: {pct}% confirmation over the last 3 months ({total} games, not counting cancellations for facility unavailability)
mustScheduleInsight.up: {base}. Improving: from {early}% to {late}% between the first and second half of the period — a good candidate to reinforce in the coming weeks.
mustScheduleInsight.down: {base}. Declining: from {early}% to {late}% — still clears the threshold, but worth confirming it holds before treating it as fixed.
mustScheduleInsight.flat: {base}. Stable over the period — expected to hold over the coming weeks if the context doesn't change.

strugglingInsight.declining: Declining from {early}% to {late}% over the last 3 months — still above the threshold, but if it keeps going it could stop being a reliable slot.
strugglingInsight.stuck: Stuck at {pct}% over the last 3 months, with no clear signs of improvement — doesn't reach the reliability threshold (55%).

mustScheduleCancelInsight.base: {pct}% cancellation over the last 3 months ({total} games, not counting cancellations for facility unavailability)
mustScheduleCancelInsight.down: {base}. Improving: from {early}% to {late}% cancellation between the first and second half of the period.
mustScheduleCancelInsight.up: {base}. Worsening: from {early}% to {late}% — still a risky time slot and the trend isn't helping.
mustScheduleCancelInsight.flat: {base}. Stable over the period — no signs of recent improvement or deterioration.

strugglingCancelInsight.worsening: Worsening: from {early}% to {late}% cancellation over the last 3 months.
strugglingCancelInsight.stuck: Elevated and stuck cancellation at {pct}% over the last 3 months, with no signs of improvement.
strugglingCancelInsight.extraSuffix: In this time slot's cancelled games, {extra}.
strugglingCancelInsight.deficitExtra: {n, plural, one{on average # player was short of the minimum} other{on average # players were short of the minimum}}
strugglingCancelInsight.droppedExtra: {n, plural, one{# player dropped out} other{# players dropped out}} on average before cancelling

board.emptyConfirmed: No slots yet clear 55% confirmation over the last 3 months with enough sample size.
board.emptyCancelled: No slot exceeds 55% cancellation over the last 3 months with enough sample size — good sign.

riskFacilities.title: Facilities to check first
riskFacilities.subtitle: Last 14 days vs. the previous 14 — data through yesterday, not real-time.

window.def: last 14 running days vs. the 14 days right before that (not the same weekday, as in a single facility's detail view), with data through yesterday.

delta.def: difference between the confirmation rate of the last 14 days and the previous 14. Negative = got worse.

severity.def: high: confirmation dropped 15+ points, or 10+ recent cancelled games. Medium: made this list on some sign of decline, without reaching those thresholds.

Trends.mainSubtitle: Trends, schedule consistency and seasonal patterns — "what to expect", not just "what happened".

facility.byFormatSectionSubtitle: Real size + court type when specified — e.g. «Turf Field 6v6»

detailTable.cappedSuffix: ({total} total, capped to the {shown} most recent)

cell.established: Established slot — {pct}% consistency across {monthsPresent} of {totalMonths} observed months.
cell.establishedDrop: Established slot ({pct}% consistency), but dropped from {priorCount} to {selectedCount} {noun} vs. {priorMonthLabel} — worth a look.
cell.streak: 2 months in a row with {noun} games (still {pct}% consistency) — could be becoming established, worth tracking.
cell.none: No {noun} games recorded in this slot yet.
cell.sporadic: {pct}% consistency ({monthsPresent} of {totalMonths} months) — sporadic for now.

slot.declining: ⚠ {dayLabel} {hour} ({formatLabel}) used to be a consistent slot ({pct}% of months with {noun} games), but dropped from {priorCount} to {selectedCount} {noun} games vs. {priorMonthLabel} — {verb}.
slot.decliningVerbCancelled: good sign, but worth confirming it's not just a one-month fluke
slot.emerging: ↗ {dayLabel} {hour} ({formatLabel}) had {noun} games two months in a row, despite not yet being historically consistent ({pct}%) — {tail}.
slot.emergingTailConfirmed: could be becoming a stable time slot, worth tracking
slot.emergingTailCancelled: could be becoming a problem time slot, worth reviewing before it sets in
slot.noChanges: No notable changes in the {word} slots this month vs. last.

Market.title: Market
Market.subtitle: Concentration, share, reputation, price and engagement by facility

vsAnteriorYear.def: change vs. the same month last year.

vsAnteriorMonth.def: change vs. the immediately preceding calendar month (not last year).

concentration.byRegionSubtitle: {month} — overview. Click a pie to see that region's detail
concentration.paretoSubtitle: {month} — individual facilities up to 80% of confirmed games; the rest grouped under "Other"

share.byMarketSubtitle: {month} — click a market to see its facilities' share
share.byFacilitySubtitle: {month} — % of this market's confirmed games that each facility represents. Click a facility to see its schedule consistency in Trends
share.empty: No confirmed games in this market for the selected month.

reputation.title: Reputation and ranking
reputation.subtitle: {month} — composite score of confirmation + occupancy + conversion. Ranking by region/market: confirmed-game count only

platinum.def: more than 1.5 standard deviations above the network average — only shown if that group exists.

tierRange.def: relative standing against the network average.

noData.def: fewer than {min} games in the month — not enough for a reliable score.

price.title: Average ticket, players per game, and estimated revenue
price.subtitle: {month} — revenue = average ticket × average players per game × confirmed games this month. Sortable columns: click = highest to lowest, again = lowest to highest, again = back to the default order

avgTicket.def: average price charged per player, unrounded.

playersPerGame.def: total confirmed players this month / number of confirmed games — not diluted by days with no games.

gamesPerMonth.def: confirmed games in the selected month. This is the default order.

revenue.def: average ticket × players/game × games this month — a simple calculation that doesn't account for facility costs (not available in this dataset).

price.empty: No price data for this filter.

engagement.title: Engagement and dropout by facility
engagement.nearMissSummary: <bold>{totalNearMiss}</bold> of {totalCancelled} cancelled games in {month} ({pct}) had reached half or more of the minimum players needed.
engagement.conversionDef: final players / (final + dropped) — a game-level proxy, not individual player tracking.
engagement.abandonmentDef: of the players who signed up, what % dropped before the game.
engagement.nearMissDef: cancelled games that had reached 50% or more of the minimum players needed — a signal that it might be worth consolidating time slots instead of offering so many in parallel.

ranking.groupTitleTop80: 80% group — facilities that concentrate the business
ranking.empty: No games in this group for the selected month.

conversion.def: final players / (final + dropped) — a game-level proxy, see the full detail in Trends.

leadTime.def: median time between confirmation and game, in the original dataset's units.

avgWaitlist.def: average waitlisted players per game, this month.

regionPies.title: Confirmed-game concentration — {region}
regionPies.subtitle: 80/20 Pareto — click to see the full detail

projection.title: {month} projection: ~{n} confirmed games
projection.detail: Projected revenue: ~{revenue} · based on {confirmed} confirmed in {elapsed} of {total} days

insights.noGames: No games recorded for the selected period/filter.
insights.lowConfirmation: ⚠ Only {pct}% of scheduled games get confirmed — demand isn't reaching the minimum player count in more than half of them.
insights.topReason: ⚠ "{reason}" explains {pct}% of cancellations ({count} games) — it's the main issue to tackle.
insights.outlier: ⚠ {facility} cancels {rate}% of its games ({games} in the period), {gap} points above the network average ({networkRate}%).
insights.highFillRate: ✓ Confirmed games fill up to {pct}% of their average capacity — worth evaluating expanding capacity or adding similar time slots.
insights.noAlerts: No relevant alerts detected for the selected period.
insights.worsened: ⚠ {facility} explains much of the change: went from {priorRate}% to {curRate}% cancellation vs. {period} (+{excess} more cancellations than expected).
insights.improved: ✓ {facility} improved notably: went from {priorRate}% to {curRate}% cancellation vs. {period} ({excess} fewer cancellations than expected).

composition.subtitle: By confirmed games — quick view, the full ranking lives in Market

marketTeaser.title: Price & engagement for this market
marketTeaser.subtitle: Quick view — the per-facility breakdown lives in Market

cancellation.title: Cancellation reasons
cancellation.compareSubtitle: Top reason and total volume for each region
cancellation.topContributorsTitle: Facilities that contributed most to cancellations
cancellation.topContributorWarning: ⚠ <link>{facility}</link> contributes the most to "{reason}" in {region} ({count} of {total}) — worth reviewing.

rating.def: average weighted by the number of reviews per game.

coverage.def: % of games that have at least one rating logged.

avgPrice.def: price charged per player, averaged over games with that data logged.

totalRevenue.def: secondary metric — the dataset mixes different pricing schemes, limited reliability.

rankings.contribConfirmSubtitle: Extra confirmations (longer bar = larger deviation) vs. what was expected if that facility had kept its own rate from {period}
rankings.contribCancelSubtitle: Extra cancellations (longer bar = larger deviation) vs. what was expected if that facility had kept its own rate from {period}

whatShows.def: each facility compared against its own behavior in the prior period — not against other facilities' average.

barLength.def: proportional to the size of the deviation — the longer it is, the further that facility drifted from what was expected based on its own recent history.

rankings.paretoConfirmedSubtitle: These {n} facilities account for {pct} of confirmed games
rankings.paretoCancelledSubtitle: These {n} facilities account for {pct} of cancellations

cumulativePctGlossary.def: percentage of total confirmed (or cancelled) games represented by that facility plus every one above it in the list — shows how many facilities it takes to explain 80% of the business.

rankings.worstRateSubtitle: Minimum 7 games in the period (1 per day over a week), so the rate is representative

confirmedCancelled.def: actual count of each, not derived from the rate.

rating.def: average weighted by number of reviews, out of 5.

sortableColumns.def: clickable to sort — clicking again reverses the order.
